title: Folhas de Operação — Entregadores
prompt:
Create a high-fidelity 1600x1000 landscape desktop app screenshot for GO Itaim Dashboard Geral, page "Entregadores". Match the selected "Folhas de Operação" design reference: warm ivory substrate, graphite type, cobalt primary controls, narrow yellow index tabs, fine ruled rows and discreet acetate surfaces. Keep dense tables legible. No browser chrome or device frame. Use official GO Itaim logo reference and preserve current navigation labels, current functionality, and Portuguese copy.

Left sidebar exact items: Principal (Visão Geral, Análise, UTR, Comparação), Operacional (Entregadores selected, Valores, Prioridade | Promo, Evolução, Dedicado), Marketing (Operacional Marketing, Marketing). Header breadcrumb "Operacional › Entregadores". Show city/date horizontal scrolling ticker in the header: green refresh icon, "Sincronizado", example clipped sequence "Guarulhos 29/09 · Manaus 28/09 · São Paulo 2.0 27/09 · Sorocaba 26/09", fade edges; user/theme at right. City/date pairs are illustrative placeholders.

Show full shared filter bar immediately below header with all visible fields and labels: row one "Período", mode "Ano/Semana" selected / "Intervalo", "Ano 2026", multiselect "Semana 05, 06, 07"; row two "Praça Todas", "Sub praça Todas", "Origem Todas", "Turno Todos", "Limpar". Ticker and filters distinct and fully visible.

Main area header "Entregadores" with a button "Exportar Excel". Five understated metric tiles: "Entregadores", "Aderência média", "Rejeição média", "Corridas ofertadas", "Total de horas". Search field with exact placeholder "Pesquisar por nome ou ID do entregador...". Below, a clear detailed horizontally expansive table with exact column labels "Saúde", "Nome", "Horas", "Ofertadas", "Aceitas", "% Aceitas", "Completadas", "% Completadas", "Aderência". Show three synthetic placeholder rows, generic names like "Entregador 001", "Entregador 002", "Entregador 003"; small color-coded health marks are okay but do not add new labels. Include simple pagination at bottom. All numbers are demonstrative and not live data. Use slim yellow page tab to mark the selected navigation section, not large yellow backgrounds.
demoData: Linhas e métricas sintéticas; não usar como dados do Supabase.
